strings.zh: 原来你不会梦到他们啊。

strings.zh: 梦境是人内心愿望的映射,{NEWLINE}你在这里的选择,{CLEAR}就是你内心最真实的想法。
strings.en: Dreams reflect the wishes{NEWLINE}in a person’s heart.{SCROLL}The choice you make here shows{NEWLINE}what you truly think deep down.

strings.zh: 一树『来吧,克雷色利亚,{NEWLINE}到精灵球里来做个美梦吧！
strings.en: Will: Come, Cresselia. Step into the{NEWLINE}Poké Ball and have a sweet dream!

strings.zh: 一树『多亏那个黑皮小子的帮忙,{NEWLINE}现在冥王做的新精灵球{CLEAR}是越来越好用了。
strings.en: Will: Thanks to that tanned kid’s help,{NEWLINE}the new Poké Balls Charon makes{CLEAR}work better and better.
strings.notes: 黑皮小子 = the same 'tanned' boy as 0121#64 (Goh, who catches Suicune with his Ball there); kept unnamed as in the zh (D-1016).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们就是为了抓捕精灵{NEWLINE}才来这里的吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You came here to{NEWLINE}capture Pokémon, didn’t you?

strings.zh: 一树『哦？怎么是你？
strings.en: Will: Oh? What are you doing here?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这里到底是什么地方？{NEWLINE}刚刚被你抓住的那只精灵{CLEAR}也是传说中的精灵吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What is this place? And{NEWLINE}the Pokémon you just caught...{CLEAR}is that a Legendary Pokémon too?

strings.zh: 一树『你居然什么都不知道{NEWLINE}就闯进了这个世界,{CLEAR}真是个有勇无谋的联盟冠军啊。{CLEAR}这里是一个独立的空间——梦境世界,{CLEAR}传说中能制造美梦的克雷色利亚{CLEAR}和制造噩梦的达克莱伊栖息在这里。{CLEAR}大奶罐就是被空间裂缝里{CLEAR}溢出的能量影响才会产生异常。{CLEAR}而我们也正是发现了这些异常,{CLEAR}才会来到这里抓捕克雷色利亚它们。
strings.en: Will: You barged into this world without{NEWLINE}knowing a thing? What a reckless{CLEAR}League Champion.{SCROLL}This is a separate dimension:{NEWLINE}the Dream World.{SCROLL}It’s home to the legendary Cresselia,{NEWLINE}who makes sweet dreams, and Darkrai,{CLEAR}who makes nightmares.{SCROLL}The Miltank went strange because of{NEWLINE}energy leaking from a rift in space.{SCROLL}We noticed those anomalies too,{NEWLINE}and came here to catch Cresselia{CLEAR}and the others.
strings.notes: RV038: meaning: 它们 = Cresselia and the others, not its kind

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们果然是冲着{NEWLINE}传说中精灵来的。{CLEAR}那么我必须在这里打倒你们{CLEAR}解放克雷色利亚。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So you’re after{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon after all.{SCROLL}Then I have to beat you{NEWLINE}here and free Cresselia.

strings.zh: 梨花『一树,我已经完成{NEWLINE}达克莱伊的捕获了,{CLEAR}你这边……
strings.en: Karen: Will, I’ve finished capturing{NEWLINE}Darkrai. How are things on your...

strings.zh: 梨花『联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}？！{NEWLINE}他是怎么跟到这里来的？
strings.en: Karen: League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!{NEWLINE}How did he follow us here?

strings.zh: 梨花『联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}？！{NEWLINE}她是怎么跟到这里来的？
strings.en: Karen: League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!{NEWLINE}How did she follow us here?

strings.zh: 一树『应该是咱们进入梦境世界时{NEWLINE}打开的空间裂缝太大,{CLEAR}把这家伙给吸进来了。
strings.en: Will: The rift we opened to get into{NEWLINE}the Dream World must have been{CLEAR}too big. It sucked this one in.

strings.zh: 梨花『怎么办,现在撤退吗？
strings.en: Karen: What now? Do we retreat?

strings.zh: 一树『别着急,既然这个冠军{NEWLINE}现在孤身一人在这里,{CLEAR}那咱们就该利用人数的优势,{CLEAR}好好陪他玩玩。{CLEAR}要是能顺道拿下他的人头,{CLEAR}那就是大功一件！
strings.en: Will: Relax. This Champion{NEWLINE}is here all alone.{SCROLL}So let’s use our numbers{NEWLINE}and have some fun with him.{SCROLL}If we can take his head while we’re{NEWLINE}at it, that’s a major achievement!

strings.zh: 一树『别着急,既然这个冠军{NEWLINE}现在孤身一人在这里,{CLEAR}那咱们就该利用人数的优势,{CLEAR}好好陪她玩玩。{CLEAR}要是能顺道拿下她的人头,{CLEAR}那就是大功一件！
strings.en: Will: Relax. This Champion{NEWLINE}is here all alone.{SCROLL}So let’s use our numbers{NEWLINE}and have some fun with her.{SCROLL}If we can take her head while we’re{NEWLINE}at it, that’s a major achievement!

strings.zh: 梨花『有道理。{NEWLINE}这可是难得的机会,{CLEAR}让这家伙尝尝咱们的厉害！
strings.en: Karen: Makes sense. A chance like{NEWLINE}this doesn’t come often. Let’s{CLEAR}show this one what we can do!

strings.zh: 一树『差距居然这么大吗……
strings.en: Will: Is the gap really that big...?

strings.zh: 梨花『怎么总是栽在这家伙手里……
strings.en: Karen: Why do we always{NEWLINE}fall to this one...?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们已经没有能力反抗了吧？{NEWLINE}那就快把装着克雷色利亚和达克莱伊{CLEAR}的精灵球交出来！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You can’t fight back{NEWLINE}anymore, can you? Then hand over the{CLEAR}Poké Balls with Cresselia and Darkrai!

strings.zh: 一树『我说冠军大人,{NEWLINE}你与其想着怎么夺走精灵,{CLEAR}不如好好想想{CLEAR}怎么离开这个梦境世界吧。
strings.en: Will: Tell me, Champion... Forget{NEWLINE}about stealing our Pokémon.{SCROLL}You’d do better to worry about how{NEWLINE}you’ll ever leave the Dream World.

strings.zh: 梨花『我们只要带着{NEWLINE}克雷色利亚和达克莱伊,{CLEAR}就能随意进出这个世界。
strings.en: Karen: As long as we have Cresselia{NEWLINE}and Darkrai, we can come and go{CLEAR}from this world as we please.

strings.zh: 一树『而没有这些精灵的你,{NEWLINE}将永远被困在这里。
strings.en: Will: But without them, you’ll{NEWLINE}be trapped here forever.

strings.zh: 梨花『哈哈哈,拜拜啦！
strings.en: Karen: Ha ha ha! Bye-bye!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶,得想办法离开才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dammit... I{NEWLINE}have to find a way out.

strings.zh: 梨花『来吧,达克莱伊,{NEWLINE}这个精灵球就是你的噩梦！
strings.en: Karen: Come, Darkrai. This{NEWLINE}Poké Ball is your nightmare!

strings.zh: 梨花『多亏那个黑皮小子的帮忙,{NEWLINE}现在冥王做的新精灵球{CLEAR}是越来越好用了。
strings.en: Karen: Thanks to that tanned kid’s{NEWLINE}help, the new Poké Balls Charon makes{CLEAR}work better and better.

What a{CLEAR}reckless League Champion.{SCROLL}This is a separate dimension:{NEWLINE}the Dream World.{SCROLL}It’s home to the legendary Cresselia,{NEWLINE}who makes sweet dreams, and Darkrai,{CLEAR}who makes nightmares.{SCROLL}The Miltank went strange because of{NEWLINE}energy leaking from a rift in space.{SCROLL}We noticed those anomalies too,{NEWLINE}and came here to catch Darkrai{CLEAR}and the others.

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So you’re after{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon after all.{SCROLL}Then I have to beat you{NEWLINE}here and free Darkrai.

strings.en: Will: Karen, I’ve finished capturing{NEWLINE}Cresselia. How are things on your...

strings.zh: 一树『联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}？！{NEWLINE}怎么会……
strings.en: Will: League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!{NEWLINE}How...?

strings.zh: 一树『难道是我打开的空间裂缝太大,{NEWLINE}把这家伙给吸进来了吗？
strings.en: Will: Did the rift I opened get so{NEWLINE}big that it sucked this one in?

strings.zh: 有些破损的古老精灵雕像。{SCROLL}雕像的里面似乎有什么东西……

strings.zh: 有些破损的古老精灵雕像。{SCROLL}雕像似乎跟身上的新月之羽{NEWLINE}发生了反应！
strings.en: An old Pokémon statue, partly broken.{SCROLL}The statue seems to be reacting{NEWLINE}to the Lunar Wing you’re carrying!

strings.en: Cresselia: Creee-se!

strings.zh: 要收服克雷色利亚吗？
strings.en: Will you catch Cresselia?
